sbic_japan.resolved_name: Three distinct regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies (SBIC East Japan, SBIC Central Japan, SBIC West Japan).
sbic_japan.legal_basis: Japan's Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Companies Act, Act No. 101 of 1963, Article 2, names Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd., Nagoya Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd., and Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd., with respective principal offices in Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka.

sbic_japan.interpretation: In this Japanese context, SBIC is the English abbreviation used by the three regional statutory investment-development companies. It is not another name for SBI Holdings, Inc. The three company profiles cross-link one another as sister companies.
sbic_japan.ownership_boundary: The reviewed primary sources establish distinct legal names, founding dates and statutory identity. They do not establish a parent/subsidiary relationship between SBI Holdings and any of the three SBIC companies.

sbi_holdings.principal_business: Management and control of the SBI Group through share ownership.

sbi_vc_trade.distinction: SBI VC Trade is part of the SBI Group; it is not one of the three regional SBIC companies.

margin_and_collateral.interpretation: SBI VC Trade's service overview states a 50% valuation factor for crypto assets and 100% for electronic payment instruments when such assets are used as leverage margin. XRP appears in the leverage product list. The generic rule does not enumerate every token's account-level collateral eligibility; do not assume every listed token is eligible in every account.

sbi_vc_trade_xrp_and_collateral.market_access_interpretation: SBI Group has a direct XRP market-access connection through its wholly owned SBI VC Trade subsidiary, which lists XRP for spot and leverage trading. This is evidence of exchange distribution and collateral rules, not proof of SBI Holdings treasury ownership, net XRP accumulation or customer trading volume.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI Group's evidenced XRP connection in these sources is through SBI VC Trade's exchange and leverage products, not demonstrated SBI Holdings treasury ownership.
support: SBI VC Trade is 100% owned by SBI Group and is a consolidated subsidiary of SBI Holdings.
SBI VC Trade lists XRP for spot and leverage trading.
disconfirming_or_missing: No SBI Holdings XRP treasury position is disclosed in these sources.
Customer balances, net deposits, trading volume and custody liabilities are not provided.
tests: Review SBI Holdings and SBI VC Trade financial disclosures for XRP inventory and custody liabilities.
Seek product-level volume and net customer flow data.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI VC Trade's generic 100% valuation factor for electronic payment instruments versus 50% for crypto assets could make stablecoin collateral more capital-efficient than volatile crypto collateral.
support: The official service overview states 50% for crypto assets and 100% for electronic payment instruments.
XRP is listed as a leverage product; USDC, RLUSD and JPYSC are listed as electronic payment instruments.
disconfirming_or_missing: The page does not enumerate token-by-token collateral eligibility for every account.
No collateral balances, utilization or resulting XRP demand are disclosed.
tests: Verify token-specific margin eligibility and account rules.
Measure collateral composition and utilization if publicly disclosed.

source_independence: The 1963 Act text and the three regional company profiles are primary company/legal disclosures. Each profile names its legal entity and cross-links the other regional SBIC companies as sister companies.
SBI Holdings and SBI VC Trade profiles are primary sources for their own corporate identities and shareholder/parent relationship.
SBI VC Trade's service overview is primary for its product list and generic collateral valuation factors; it does not disclose token-specific customer collateral balances.
The SBIC East and West ChatGPT pages are official educational event notices; they do not establish an OpenAI commercial relationship.
The Science Information Systems ChatGPT reference is an investee-company listing, not an SBIC-owned product.
